scientific_question: On the accepted constant-full-carry c_proj path, does task-conditioned left/output rotation recover the row-Gram orientation and endpoint transport missing from the hidden64+24 right-only chart?

causal_scope.changed_variable: number of task-conditioned sparse output/left rotation stages after the fixed hidden64+24 right chart
fixed_variables: layers, score steps, and seed family

earlier_bounded_carry_replay.limitation: It compared output transport with extra right stages under decay 0.5, not with the production right-only chart under accepted full carry.

evidence_before_registration.interpretation: Right-only capacity changes are exhausted, but exact bilateral orthogonal transport nearly saturates dense phase endpoints. A left/output full-carry replay is the missing causal discriminator and must precede non-orthogonal structure.

teacher_forcing_protocol.trajectory_reset: Each arm/layer starts once from exact dense step-0 c_proj and follows all 238 updates without phase reset.
teacher_forcing_protocol.per_step_target: Use recorded dense W[t+1]-W[t], remove dense decoupled weight decay, add the arm's prior compression residual with decay 1.0, fit hidden/right 64+24, fit the candidate output/left stages to the remaining transposed residual, then apply weight decay once.
teacher_forcing_protocol.matching: Both sides use the deterministic fast task-conditioned matcher and exact diagonal-metric Givens angles. The output pass acts on W^T, so its right rotations are left rotations of W.
teacher_forcing_protocol.causality: At step t an arm sees only its current weight, current recorded dense update, and its own prior compression residual.
teacher_forcing_protocol.interpretation: This optimistic zero-update replay tests bilateral transport under the accepted temporal mechanism; no LM loss is evaluated.

metrics.aggregate: Energy-weight endpoint and row-Gram recovery across five layers, endpoint and row-Gram error ratios, maximum feedback ratio, requested-update recovery, and per-layer wins.

registered_decision_rule.candidate_pass: All metrics must be finite. Candidate endpoint recovery must be no worse than control at every score step; terminal endpoint-error energy and terminal row-Gram-error energy must each be at most 0.85x control; terminal maximum feedback norm must be at most 0.95x control; terminal mean requested-update recovery must be no worse than control; and candidate must win at least 4/5 terminal layers.
registered_decision_rule.selection: Choose the first passing output depth. If neither passes, close the practical bilateral orthogonal family under full carry and move to a bounded direction-conditioned non-orthogonal residual.
registered_decision_rule.authorization_on_pass: Implement only the selected bilateral optimizer path with no learned dense basis, add exact update/resume tests, then separately preregister and directly poll an exact 124M >=20% MFU preflight. No language-model training is authorized by this plan.
registered_decision_rule.authorization_on_failure: Do not train output rotations. Quantify which row-Gram component remains and preregister the smallest bounded task-conditioned non-orthogonal residual.
